evidence.title: React Vibe – Animated, Motion-First UI Components for React
GitHub - siddhantmani/reactvibe: React animation library with copy-paste UI components. Built with Framer Motion and Tailwind. Open source, production-ready React components. · GitHub

name: React Vibe
summary: Motion-first React components, UI blocks and dashboard systems built with Framer Motion and Tailwind.
description: 74 production-ready React components across seven categories: dashboard systems (finance, accounts, transactions, budgets, reports), UI blocks (heroes, pricing, FAQ, testimonials, CTA, navbars, footers), charts, lists, tables and interactive motion effects. Copy the source, customize it and ship; components that animate need Framer Motion installed once in your project.
contains: dashboard systems: finance overview, accounts, transactions, budgets, investments, reports, integrations
motion components: Branch Flow, Hub Flow, Network Pulse, Pipeline, Signal, Waveform, Orbit Border and more
sections: hero, pricing, FAQ, testimonials, CTA, navigation, footer
copy-paste source; only Framer Motion needs to be installed
MIT licensed, free for commercial use
